mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (indicating an accommodative monetary policy stance) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a deteriorating labor market and impending recession, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 112 and HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a financial crisis (as indicated by a sharp decline in industrial production and rising unemployment), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but in non-crisis periods, the same rate cut does not produce positive returns.
failure_condition: In financial crisis periods (defined by INDPRO < 110 and UNRATE > 6.0), SPX produces negative 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of total employment (PAYEMS) relative to historical norms signals a weak labor market and impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is below 140,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a deflationary risk, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate prolonged economic stagnation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5 and CPIAUCSL < 218, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1000 thousand units signals a severe housing market contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
